name: 다중 스케일 엔트로피 분석
description: Computes sample entropy at multiple time scales to detect complexity differences between real and AI images (Costa et al., 2002).
mechanism:
이 방법은 applies Costa et al.'s (2002) Multiscale Entropy (MSE) framework to quantify image complexity across scales:

1. **Coarse-Graining**: The image signal is coarse-grained at multiple temporal scales τ by averaging non-overlapping windows of length τ: yⱼ(τ) = (1/τ)Σᵢ₌₍ⱼ₋₁₎τ₊₁ʲᵗ xᵢ. This creates a family of representations capturing structure at different resolutions.

2. **SampleEntropy계산**: At each scale τ, sample entropy SampEn(m, r, N) is calculated — measuring the negative natural logarithm of the conditional probability that sequences similar for m points remain similar for m+1 points within tolerance r. This quantifies irregularity without requiring stationarity.

3. **MSECurveConstruction**: The entropy values across scales form the MSE curve. Natural images exhibit a characteristic MSE profile: high entropy at fine scales (sensor noise, texture detail) with controlled decay at coarse scales reflecting structured content.

4. **ComplexityIndex계산**: The area under the MSE curve (Complexity Index, CI) provides a single measure of multi-scale complexity. AI 생성 images 일반적으로 show abnormal MSE profiles — either excessively smooth (low MSE across all scales) or with artificial periodicity absent in natural images.

5. **이상 감지**: The MSE curve shape is compared against reference distributions from natural images. Deviations indicate synthetic generation — diffusion models often produce overly regular fine-scale structure, while GANs may show characteristic entropy dips at specific scales corresponding to generator architecture artifacts.
parameters: 분석 유형: 자동 통계\n점수 범위: 0(실제)~100(AI 생성)
source: 디지털 포렌식 및 AI 콘텐츠 탐지 관련 동료 검토 연구 기반.
useCase: AI 생성 콘텐츠를 탐지하기 위한 다중 신호 분석 파이프라인의 일부로 사용.
strengths: • 연구 기반 방법론\n• 빠른 계산 속도\n• 다른 탐지 방법과 보완적
limitations: • 정확도는 입력 품질에 따라 변동\n• 다른 방법과 함께 사용하는 것이 최적

references.title: Costa, M. et al. (2002). Multiscale Entropy Analysis of Complex Physiologic Time Series. Physical Review Letters.
Richman, J.S. & Moorman, J.R. (2000). Physiological Time-series Analysis Using Approximate Entropy. AJP Heart.
